entities.summary: Ovadia Eli is an Israeli former politician who served as a member of the Knesset for Likud from 1984 until 1996, Deputy Minister of Defense between 1991 and 1992, and mayor of Afula from 1978 until 1991. Since leaving the Knesset he has headed several government-owned companies and is currently the CEO of the Israel Airports Authority.
